thread:
Maya (Support): Escalating Northbridge Labs trial. New issue: SSO redirect loop for 4 users + bulk ingest failing with 422 schema errors. Trial expires in 10 days. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-7321 :rotating_light:
Theo (CS): Thanks Maya. Can you confirm scope: all users in tenant or specific identity provider? Also paste the 422 payload sample if available.
Maya (Support): Only users via our IdP connector `okta-northbridge` see redirect loop. 422 sample: `{"error":"invalid_schema","details":"missing field 'source_id'"}`. Appears when they switch from CSV ingest to JSON stream. Logs attached to the ticket.
Priya (AE): Northbridge is a strategic pilot; renewal conversation next month. If POC stalls we risk slipping. Can CS propose a low-effort workaround so their engineers can continue testing?
Marco (Solutions): Likely two separate issues: SSO session cookie domain + parser strictness on JSON. Quick fixes: 1) add `Set-Cookie SameSite=None; Secure; Domain=.northbridge.io` on the IdP callback (infra team), 2) relax ingest parser to accept optional `source_id` for pilot users or provide a migration script. I can PR a parser tolerance patch.
infra-bot: Incident note created: infra/identity/2893. On-call notified. ETA for IdP cookie tweak: ~4h.
Liam (Customer): Hi all 1F60A. We can add `source_id` but it requires changes on our side. Prefer Redwood to accept legacy payloads for the pilot if feasible. Also SSO is blocking half the team from logging in to the dashboard.
Theo (CS): Proposed CS plan: 1) Temporary trial extension + pilot support (14 days) to give runway, 2) Enable a Per-tenant ingest compatibility flag for `northbridge` to accept missing `source_id` for 7 days, 3) Prioritise IdP cookie fix with infra, 4) Schedule enablement + handover call tomorrow 11am PT. Who can own the compatibility flag?
Marco (Solutions): I can ship the compatibility flag as a feature toggle scoped to `account=northbridge`. Small change, feature-flagged in runtime; can be ready in ~6h after infra change.
Priya (AE): I will flag renewal to executive sponsor and say CS has a remediation plan. Please copy me on comms to the customer.
Maya (Support): Ops approved trial extension for 14 days and priority bug triage. Adding note in ticket. :white_check_mark:
Theo (CS): Owner assigned = Theo. I'll draft the customer email explaining short-term steps, the timeline, and the enablement agenda. Draft will include: how to toggle compatibility, recommended ingest changes (sample migration script), and date/time for the call.
Liam (Customer): Appreciate it. Zoom link in ticket. Success criteria for us: dashboard access for all invited users, ingest throughput hitting 200docs/min without schema drops.
Marco (Solutions): Quick internal note: we'll emit a compatibility warning header `X-Redwood-Ingest: legacy-accepted` when the flag is enabled so customer knows we're in tolerant mode.
Theo (CS): Action items for thread: owner=Theo, trial-extension=14d, infra-cookie=ETA4h, feature-flag=Marco(6h), enablement-call=scheduled tomorrow 11am PT. I'll post comms and a short feedback survey post-call.
Priya (AE): Good. If anything changes I'll escalate to the AM. Please ping me if we need an exec-level intro.
Maya (Support): Follow-up: added minimal repro for 422 to the ticket and included steps to reproduce SSO redirect loop.
infra-bot: IdP cookie tweak deployed to staging. Canary in 30m.
Marco (Solutions): Canary looks clean. I'll rollout feature flag to northbridge and run their sample ingest. Will update in thread.
Theo (CS): Closing loop for now 1F4CB: will capture enablement notes, gap in docs (ingest schema migration guide), and post-call feedback.
